newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 1.239 billion yuan from 982 million yuan on Thursday with the seven-day contract the most actively traded.
The market was still quiet and most of the big state-run banks remained side-lined, traders said, adding that non-banking financial institutions were the most active participants.

There were no new domestic A share issues on Friday, so buying from the short-term financial centres -- money brokerages owned by the central bank -- declined, traders said, adding that volumes were expected to fall further next week with only two new A share issues scheduled.
Some insurance companies traded actively on Friday, traders said but did not know the reasons.
"Trading will remain dull next week pending news on a cut in interest rates and bank deposit reserve ratios," one trader said.
